description: This file defines an enumeration 'MetricDirection' indicating the direction of a counter, specifically whether it is inbound or outbound, in the context of message counting within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MetricDirection
classes.description: Enumeration representing message counting directions, with methods to retrieve direction by name and to get the direction's label.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the MetricDirection instance.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Factory method that returns an Optional containing the MetricDirection matching the given name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the direction as a string.
